## Local verification

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm test:changelog`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm seed`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has appropriate regression coverage
